tests.instructions: Create a fresh >=60-second two-deck master recording on this exact SHA while using representative mixer/DSP and at least one performance action. Stop recording. Use the new in-app audio player to replay the saved blob.
pass: Fresh blob is non-empty and has an audio MIME type.
In-app audio player becomes visible and points at the same saved blob as the download link.
Human confirms the replayed saved recording contains the post-master program and has no abnormal recorder-caused dropouts.

tests.instructions: With both decks audible and SYNC active, schedule the 4-second A-to-B crossfade and block the main thread for 600 ms during it.
pass: Crossfade continues through the UI stall and reaches B.
A/B/mixer continue advancing with 0 new frame discontinuities.
Follower transportSeekCount does not increase from SYNC maintenance.
Human explicitly confirms the crossfade is audible and continuous with no UI-stall dropout.

tests.instructions: During the same physical session exercise one Cue, Hot Cue, Loop or Jog action while Phase 10 recording/automation services are active.
pass: SYNC remains locked/tracking or re-locks normally after the explicit performance jump.
0 new A/B/mixer discontinuities attributable to Phase 10 services.

tests.instructions: If a physical MIDI controller and Web MIDI permission are available, repeat connect/learn/control. Otherwise carry NOT_EVALUATED forward as an environmental limitation.
pass: If evaluated, physical control works on the mapped mixer target.
If unavailable, NOT_EVALUATED is accepted and does not block Phase 10.
